text:
Zoe Liu: Hey everyone — I'm Zoe, starting today on eng-platform. First day! Quick Qs: where's the VPN setup guide? Who's the devex on-call this week? Also I'm on a Mac M2 — any MDM steps I should run? :wave:

Priya Rao: welcome Zoe!! :raised_hands: VPN guide is pinned in #devex. If you need a cert, @onboard-bot can provision one. DM me if you want the onboarding playlist or a quick tour of the console.

Aaron Kim: hey Zoe — I'm your onboarding buddy for the next 2 weeks, ping me anytime. For M2, run:
```bash
sudo profiles install /opt/company/mdm.mobileconfig
sudo reboot
```
If JAMF shows "provisioning" for more than 10 mins, tell me and I'll poke infra.

onboard-bot: New hire account created: Zoe Liu. AD group: engineers. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/zoe_liu. VPN cert provisioning: request sent, ETA ~15 minutes.

Zoe Liu: amazing, thanks everyone! Also random question — where do we get the sticker pack? I collect stickers :sunglasses:

Marta (People Ops): Hi Zoe — welcome! We left a sticker pack and a welcome kit on your desk, and we shipped one to your home address as well (tracking 1Z999AA10123456789). Lunch with the team next Thursday at 12:30pm if you wanna join.

Raj Patel: hi Zoe — quick heads up: first-week ramp task is a tiny PR to add a README for the model-scaling demo (good intro to infra + runtime). Link: https://git.redwood.internal/model-scaling/blob/main/README.md. Want to pair later today?

Zoe Liu: happy to pair — 3pm PT works for me. I'll bring snacks. :)

Aaron Kim: perfect, 3pm PT zoom coming in #calendar. I’ll drop the invite and a short checklist for the demo. See you then! :slightly_smiling_face:
